title.en: Removing Copper and Cement From the List of Export Products Subject to Duty Provided for Under Republic Act No. 1937, Other Wise Known as the "Tariff and Customs Code", as Amended

text.en:
Copper and cement are hereby excluded from the list of export products subject to duty as provided
under Section 514, title III of the tariff and Customs Code, as amended.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
